notes:
- An update could fail with "the process cannot access the file" and stop halfway, usually on clrjit.dll, when a second copy of the launcher was still running. It waits for those to close now, and moves a file that is still open aside instead of giving up on it.
- If a file really cannot be replaced, the update says which one and tells you to close Iris Client, instead of showing a raw Windows error. The old build is left working rather than half overwritten.
- Files moved aside during an update are cleared away on the next start.
